mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average, the discount rate for future cash flows declines, lowering the present value of expected dividends and thereby pushing S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is below average, 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive rate hike anticipation in market pricing, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2% and accelerating, 20-day forward returns are non-negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in labor market activity as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 new nonfarm payrolls in a month is associated with increased consumer confidence and corporate hiring plans, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: In months with PAYEMS > 150000, 5-day forward returns are negative (mean < 0, t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive 2-month decline in GDPC1 industrial production signals weakening supply-side constraints, prompting market participants to price in stronger future demand and thus drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 shows two consecutive months of decline
failure_condition: GDPC1 declines for two months but 20-day forward returns are not positive (mean <= 0, t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the RSAFS (retail sales) falls by more than 5% in a month compared to the prior month, it indicates softening demand or inventory buildup, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines >5% but 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (mean > -0.1, t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising UNRATE (unemployment) and a declining HOUST (housing starts) creates a dual signal of labor market slack and construction slowdown, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises while HOUST falls, but 20-day forward returns are not negative (mean > 0, t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a tightening cycle characterized by FEDFUNDS rising above 5%, the market anticipates higher future policy rates, which increases the real discount rate and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (mean >= 0, t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO (industrial production) index remains flat for three consecutive months, it suggests a loss of momentum in output growth, which is interpreted by markets as a risk of soft demand and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO is flat for three consecutive months
failure_condition: INDPRO flat for 3 months but 20-day forward returns are not negative (mean > 0, t-test p > 0.05).
